sources.title: MobileViTV2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MobileViTV2 is the second version of MobileViT, constructed by replacing the multi-headed self-attention in MobileViT with separable self-attention. The abstract from the paper is the following: Mobile vision transformers (MobileViT) can achieve state-of-the-art performance across several mobile vision tasks, including classification and detection.
